fields.label: Site Logo
fields.name: site_logo
fields.instructions: Upload or choose the primary website logo. If empty, the WordPress Customizer logo will be used.

fields.label: Google Tag ID
fields.name: google_tag_id
fields.instructions: Measurement ID. Leave empty to disable the tag.

fields.label: Top Bar Left Text
fields.name: topbar_left
fields.default_value: Free Shipping on Orders Over $299 - Australia Wide

fields.label: Header & Contact Phone Number
fields.name: whatsapp_number
fields.instructions: Australian contact phone number (e.g. 0488 841 833). Displayed in the header, mobile drawer and top bar. Leave empty to hide the phone button.

fields.label: Header Phone Button Text
fields.name: whatsapp_button_text
fields.instructions: Custom text or phone number shown on the header phone button (e.g. 0488 841 833). Leave blank to automatically format the phone number above.

fields.label: Header Phone Button Link / URL
fields.name: whatsapp_button_url
fields.instructions: Optional custom link or phone number for the header button (e.g. tel:0488841833). If left blank, it defaults to calling the phone number above.

fields.label: Support Email
fields.name: support_email
fields.instructions: Used for the support contact address.

fields.label: Support CTA Representative Image (Guy with Phone)
fields.name: support_cta_image
fields.instructions: Global representative image for the Support CTA banner. Defaults to bundled guy with phone photo.

fields.label: Working Days
fields.name: working_days
fields.instructions: Displayed in the footer contact section (e.g. 'Monday to Sunday').

fields.label: Office Hours
fields.name: office_hours
fields.instructions: Displayed in the footer contact section (e.g. '24/7').

fields.label: Enable Pre-Footer Trust Badges (Inner Pages)
fields.name: pre_footer_badges_enabled
fields.instructions: Toggle the 4 trust badge cards displayed above the footer on all inner pages.
fields.message: Display trust badge cards on inner pages

fields.label: Pre-Footer Trust Badges (Inner Pages)
fields.name: pre_footer_badges
fields.instructions: Edit the trust badge cards shown before the footer across all inner pages.

choices.po_box_delivery: PO Box and Parcel Locker Delivery

sub_fields.label: Custom Icon (Image/SVG)
sub_fields.name: custom_icon
sub_fields.instructions: Used only if Icon Style is set to Custom

fields.label: Footer Logo
fields.name: footer_logo
fields.instructions: Optional footer logo. If empty, the primary site logo will be used.

fields.label: SSL Text
fields.name: ssl_text
fields.instructions: Displayed in footer trust badges. If left empty, this badge will disappear.

fields.label: Dispatch Text
fields.name: dispatch_text
fields.instructions: Displayed in footer trust badges. If left empty, this badge will disappear.

fields.label: Checkout Text
fields.name: checkout_text
fields.instructions: Displayed in footer trust badges. If left empty, this badge will disappear.

fields.label: Location / Address Text
fields.name: location_text
fields.instructions: Address displayed in the footer contact block.
fields.default_value: Corporate Registry: 50 Holt St, Surry Hills, 2010, NSW

fields.label: Contact Section Heading
fields.name: footer_contact_heading
fields.instructions: Heading displayed above contact information in footer.

fields.label: Payment Accepted Heading
fields.name: footer_payments_heading
fields.instructions: Heading displayed above payment method logos in footer.

fields.label: Payment Accepted Logos
fields.name: footer_payment_images
fields.instructions: Upload accepted payment logos (e.g. Commonwealth Bank, Osko, PayID). If left empty, this section will disappear.

fields.label: Shipping Partner Heading
fields.name: footer_shipping_heading
fields.instructions: Heading displayed above shipping partner logos in footer.

fields.label: Shipping Partner Logos
fields.name: footer_shipping_images
fields.instructions: Upload shipping partner logos (e.g. Australia Post). If left empty, this section will disappear.

fields.label: Thank You Heading
fields.name: thankyou_heading
fields.instructions: Warning note in order confirmation emails.

fields.label: Thank You Text
fields.name: thankyou_text
fields.instructions: Estimated delivery timeline note shown above the order details table.
fields.default_value: Thank you for your order. Please complete your payment using EFT or PayID below.

fields.label: PayID Number
fields.name: payid_number
fields.instructions: PayID phone number or identifier displayed on the thank you page (e.g. 0400 000 000).

fields.label: Transfer Reference / Description Warning Callout
fields.name: checkout_bacs_warning
fields.instructions: Dark blue callout text shown under PayID instructions.
fields.default_value: DO NOT reference anything related to medicine or website name. Just mention your order number.

fields.label: Payment Done Notice
fields.name: checkout_receipt_notice
fields.instructions: Instruction notice below the bank cards (use {email} as placeholder for the contact email).

fields.label: Shipping Notice / Note
fields.name: checkout_shipping_note
fields.instructions: Estimated delivery timeline note shown above the order details table.
fields.default_value: The average shipping time is 15-22 days. Please note that delivery may take up to 30 days from the date of dispatch due to potential disruptions in postal services caused by weather issues or natural disaster.

fields.label: Order Confirmation Email - Intro Message
fields.name: email_on_hold_intro
fields.instructions: Intro paragraph shown after 'Hi [Customer Name],' in order confirmation emails.
fields.default_value: We've received your order and it's currently on hold until we can confirm your payment has been processed.

fields.label: Order Confirmation Email - Payment Instruction
fields.name: email_on_hold_instruction
fields.instructions: Payment instruction paragraph in order confirmation emails.
fields.default_value: Please complete your payment using EFT or PayID below with your order number.

fields.label: Order Confirmation Email - Transfer Warning Note
fields.name: email_on_hold_warning
fields.instructions: Warning note in order confirmation emails.
fields.default_value: DO NOT reference anything related to medicine or website name. Just mention your order number.

fields.label: Breadcrumb: Home
fields.name: breadcrumb_home_label
fields.instructions: First link of the breadcrumb at the top of every inner page.

fields.label: Show the mascot in page headers
fields.name: page_hero_mascot
fields.instructions: The tablet character peeking over the bottom edge of the header on inner pages.

fields.label: Pagination: screen reader label
fields.name: pagination_label
fields.instructions: Read aloud for page numbers under article and review lists.

fields.label: Pagination: Previous
fields.name: pagination_previous_label
fields.instructions: Link to the previous page of articles or reviews.

fields.label: Pagination: Next
fields.name: pagination_next_label
fields.instructions: Link to the next page of articles or reviews.

fields.label: Contact page: email label
fields.name: contact_label_email
fields.instructions: Above the email address on the Contact page.

fields.label: Contact page: phone label
fields.name: contact_label_phone
fields.instructions: Above the phone number on the Contact page.

fields.label: Contact page: address label
fields.name: contact_label_address
fields.instructions: Above the address on the Contact page.

fields.label: Reviews page: heading
fields.name: reviews_page_heading
fields.instructions: Page header of the Reviews page.

fields.label: Reviews page: score line
fields.name: reviews_page_summary
fields.instructions: Under the average score. {score} is the average and {count} the number of published reviews.

fields.label: Reviews page: form heading and button
fields.name: reviews_form_heading
fields.instructions: Heading above the review form, and the button in the score panel that jumps to it. The form only shows when Gravity Forms is active.

fields.label: Articles page: All link
fields.name: blog_all_label
fields.instructions: First category link above the article list.

fields.label: Articles page: categories (screen reader label)
fields.name: blog_categories_label
fields.instructions: Read aloud for the row of category links.

fields.label: Article page: related articles heading
fields.name: article_related_heading
fields.instructions: Heading above the related articles at the bottom of an article. Leave empty to hide them.

fields.label: Article list: default heading
fields.name: archive_default_title
fields.instructions: Page header of the articles list when no category or search applies.

fields.label: Search results: heading
fields.name: search_title
fields.instructions: Page header of search results. {query} is what the visitor searched for.

fields.label: Search results: nothing found heading
fields.name: search_empty_heading
fields.instructions: Shown when a search finds nothing.

fields.label: Search results: nothing found text
fields.name: search_empty_text
fields.instructions: Under the nothing found heading.

fields.label: Article list: nothing published heading
fields.name: empty_posts_heading
fields.instructions: Shown when a category or the article list has no posts.

fields.label: Article list: nothing published text
fields.name: empty_posts_text
fields.instructions: Under the nothing published heading.
fields.default_value: Please check back for new articles.

fields.label: Article page: reading time
fields.name: article_read_time_label
fields.instructions: Under the article title. {minutes} is calculated from the article length. Leave empty to hide it.

fields.label: Policy pages: section count
fields.name: policy_sections_label
fields.instructions: In the header of long text pages such as the policies. {count} is the number of headings on the page. Leave empty to hide it.

fields.label: Articles page: search box placeholder
fields.name: blog_search_placeholder
fields.instructions: Inside the search box in the header of the Insights page and article lists.

fields.label: Articles page: search button
fields.name: blog_search_button
fields.instructions: Button next to the search box.

fields.label: Order steps: Cart
fields.name: checkout_step_cart
fields.instructions: First step shown in the header of the cart and checkout pages.

fields.label: Order steps: Checkout
fields.name: checkout_step_checkout
fields.instructions: Second step.

fields.label: Order steps: Order complete
fields.name: checkout_step_done
fields.instructions: Third step, highlighted on the order confirmation page.

fields.label: 404 Heading
fields.name: not_found_heading
fields.default_value: Oops! That page can't be found.

fields.label: 404 Text
fields.name: not_found_text
fields.default_value: It looks like nothing was found at this location.
